verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਗ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui charan kamal taeh jag madhukar hai ||

en.bdb: A Sikh who is engrossed in the elixir-like name of the Lord by virtue of the holy dust of the feet of True Guru (due to His company) has the whole world becoming his devotees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਗਦ ਗਦ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sree gur sabadh dhun sun gadh gadh hoi a(n)mirat bachan taeh jagat udhar hai ||

en.bdb: A Sikh of the Guru whose every hair blooms hearing the melody of True Guru blessed Naam Simran, his elixir-like words can sail the world across the worldly ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਦੋਖ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ki(n)chat kaTaachh kirapaa gur dhiaa nidhaan sarab nidhaan dhaan dhokh dhukh har hai ||

en.bdb: A Sikh of the Guru who receives even a very small blessing of the True Guru, becomes capable of giving away all the treasures and allaying the distresses of the others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਤਾਸੁ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੧੬॥
verses.translit_en: sree gur dhaasan dhaas dhaasan dhaasaan dhaas taas na i(n)dhraadh brahamaadh samasar hai ||216||

en.bdb: A Sikh who serves the servants of the slaves of the True Guru (who becomes down to earth humble) cannot even be equated with god Indra, Brahma and all the gods and goddesses put together. (216)
